description: Ministry of Justice and Prison Reforms - Order declaring that the Provisions of the Transfer of Offenders act, (5/1995) to apply on Thailand..
reasoning: This gazette content contains an order made under the Transfer of Offenders Act, No. 5 of 1995, declaring that the provisions of this Act shall apply to Thailand. This constitutes a legal/regulatory matter involving the application of an existing law to a specific country, fitting the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters, including statutory instruments and legal notices.
